title: South Coast Railroad Museum

services.name: engaging exhibits
services.desc: At the South Coast Railroad Museum, we offer a variety of engaging programs and exhibits that bring the rich history of the railroad and the Goleta Depot to life. Whether you’re a lifelong train enthusiast or a family looking for an educational day out, our exhibits and interactive experiences provide something for everyone. Discover the fascinating history of railroading on the South Coast and the pivotal role the Goleta Depot played in connecting communities. Our exhibits are designed to educate, entertain, and inspire visitors of all ages. services.name: self-guided tours
services.desc: Explore the rich history of the Goleta Depot through our virtual walking tour. This interactive experience allows you to journey through the depot’s key points of interest from the comfort of your home. Each stop on the tour offers a glimpse into the depot’s past, highlighting its significance in the development of the Goleta Valley and its preservation as part of the South Coast Railroad Museum. Below, you’ll find a detailed map of the depot, along with descriptions of the numbered points of interest that tell the story of this historic landmark. blurb: Experience the charm of the historic Goleta Depot, just a short drive from downtown Santa Barbara, at the South Coast Railroad Museum. As a former Southern Pacific Railroad station built in 1901, this Santa Barbara train museum highlights the railroad’s impact on the Goleta Valley and the greater Santa Barbara area.
